size_guide.title: Find your size
size_guide.lede_html:
Enter your bust, waist, hips and height to see the recommended size for this dress.
The result is passed on to the reservation form.
size_guide.hint: Measure over underwear, keeping the tape level.
size_guide.note: This is a guide only. Please check the fit when you try the dress on.
size_guide.cta: Book a fitting with this result

errors.need_bust_waist: Please enter your bust and waist.

result.caution_far: Your measurements are outside the size chart. Alterations may be needed, so please contact us.
result.height_none: Length not set because height was not entered
result.height_unconfirmed: The chart has no length for {height} cm ({suffix}), so only the size number is shown. Please ask about length at your fitting
result.avail_diff: — Different from your recommended size. Please contact us about alterations.
result.avail_no_height: — Same size number. Length was not checked because height was not entered.
result.avail_tier_diff: — Same size number, but a different length. Please check the length at your fitting.

reserve.title: Reservation
reserve.lede: Like replying to an invitation, you can reserve in five steps. We ask for your measurements and delivery details all at once, so no follow-up confirmation email is needed.
reserve.noscript: This form needs JavaScript. Please enable it in your browser, or reserve by phone.
